parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Customer Retention Engine (PET WF8)

**🎯 Purpose:** Intelligent customer retention system with personalized offers and loyalty tracking

**🚀 Features:**
• **Smart Tier Classification:** Automatically categorizes customers (New, Regular, Loyal, VIP)
• **Personalized Offers:** Tailored discounts and benefits based on customer history
• **Retention Scoring:** Calculates retention probability and churn risk
• **Multi-Channel Engagement:** Email campaigns and SMS reminders
• **Loyalty Tracking:** Comprehensive customer relationship management

**⚡ Workflow Process:**
1. **Triggered by Review Request:** Activated after WF7 review request workflow
2. **Customer Analysis:** Retrieves customer history and loyalty data
3. **Tier Classification:** Determines customer tier based on visit frequency and spending
4. **Retention Strategy:** Calculates personalized retention approach
5. **Targeted Communication:** Sends tier-appropriate offers and benefits
6. **Loyalty Database Update:** Records retention campaign and customer metrics
7. **Future Engagement:** Schedules next retention cycle based on customer tier
8. **Wellness Reminders:** Automated follow-up for ongoing engagement

**📊 Customer Tiers:**
• **VIP:** 10+ visits OR $1000+ spent (20% discounts, 60-day cycle)
• **Loyal:** 5+ visits OR $500+ spent (15% discounts, 75-day cycle)
• **Regular:** 3+ visits (10% discounts, 90-day cycle)
• **New:** <3 visits (5% welcome offers, 120-day cycle)

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Master Appointments: {{MASTER_APPOINTMENTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Loyalty Database: {{CUSTOMER_LOYALTY_SHEET_ID}}
• Email Marketing: SMTP + HTML templates
